open_points.text: - correct_expense: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ExpenseConflictError, writing nothing, when get_expense_aggregate of the expenses repository of that transaction returns no expense for expense_id or returns an expense whose project_id is not the project_id of the context.

open_points.question: Must the contract return Expense instead, or must the note say that the returned ExpenseAggregate is absent or contains an Expense belonging to another project?
